class_weight: balanced for LR/DT/RF; KNN vote weights only; no synthetic resampling
permutation: 10 shuffles of each original column in outer test partition; F1 decrease; descriptive variability only
geography_change: E4 adds coordinates and basin; E1 is the removal comparison required by proposal
type_change: E2 and fixed M(e) rule are blueprint refinements, not original proposal models
group_sensitivity: 3 outer/inner climate-cell grouped folds when feasible; no adjacent-cell buffer and no claim of basin transfer
interpretation: retrospective historical designation classification; scores are not flood probabilities
boundary_rule: source Nepal AND full polygon covered by research ADM0; excluded disagreements logged before modelling
